topic: Lexical V→N derivation: M-reduction of argument structure
notes: Another particularly telling example is given in (25) which shows that the purely grammatical constraint “possessor ≠ internal argument of the base verb” cannot be overridden by pragmatics. Pragmatically, people are usually the ones who get oppressed but this reading is absent in (25b) which presents people as the unfair oppressor.
